descriptionChirho: To act as an adversary, oppose, or bring accusation against someone, used in all Qal forms including participle ('my accusers'), imperfect ('they accuse me'), and infinitive ('to accuse him'). Spanish mis adversarios/me acusan ('my adversaries / they accuse me'), Arabic khuSumi/yuaaduunani ('my opponents / they oppose me'), Hindi mere virodhi/virodh karte hain ('my opponents / they oppose'), Korean daejeokhaneun jadeul ('those who oppose'). The participial, finite, and infinitival forms all express the same accusatory-adversarial action.
